user.title: Discover Lifedomus gateways
user.description: Select a gateway or choose to enter a host manually.

gateway_manual.title: Manual host entry
gateway_manual.description: Enter the host (IP address or hostname) of your Lifedomus gateway.

site_select.title: Select a site
site_select.description: Choose the site to configure on this gateway.

user_select.title: Select a user
user_select.description: Choose the user for this site.

password.title: Authentication
password.description: Enter the password for the selected user.

alarm_code.title: Alarm panel detected
alarm_code.description: An alarm panel was detected on this site. Enter the 6-digit access code now, or leave the field empty to skip. During reconfiguration, you can also clear the stored code.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway at {host} rejected the stored password. Enter the current password of the configured user.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the gateway
reconfigure.description: Enter the current host (IP address or hostname) of the gateway. The alarm code can be reviewed in the next step.

error.alarm_code_denied: Alarm code was denied by the gateway.

error.no_site_configured: No site configured on this gateway.

abort.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the gateway.
abort.no_user_configured: No user configured on this site.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Reconfiguration completed. The entry was updated.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The host does not lead to the gateway and site of this entry.
